snippet_primary: "Etsy is a unique marketplace. Buyers come here to purchase items that they might not find anywhere else, or to spark their own creativity. As such, everything listed for sale on Etsy must be made, designed, handpicked, or sourced by a seller."
subject_exact: Etsy policy requires all items listed for sale to be made, designed, handpicked, or sourced by the seller; mass-manufactured resale without seller involvement is not permitted
